channel.title: The Tidewater News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Tidewater News (thetidewaternews.com)

item.title: How to Choose a Moving Company You Can Actually Trust
item.description: Relocating to a new home or office is a major life event—one that demands trustworthy support.

item.title: Southampton announces change in county admin
item.description: Southampton County Board approves separation with Administrator Brian Thrower, placing him on leave until June 30, 2026, and names Deputy Administrator Lynette Lowe acting county administrator.

item.title: Superintendent’s Town Hall Meeting set for Feb. 25
item.description: Franklin schools chief opens Feb. 25 town hall to entire community, with rotating breakout sessions on academics, services, HR, operations and Q&A at J.P. King Jr. Career & Technical Academy.

item.title: Camp opens fall 2026 scholarship application
item.description: Paul D. Camp Community College has opened its Fall 2026 scholarship application, available to new and current students and high school seniors through April 29 at pdc.edu.

item.title: Planning underway for Franklin’s 150th
item.description: Franklin’s 150th birthday will be marked March 15 at Barrett’s Landing with a 150-voice choir and a Memory Chest collecting materials from organizations across the community.

item.title: The Art of Contemporary Sports Photography
item.description: Sports photography has always been a unique art form.

item.title: Roland C. Turner
item.description: Roland Christopher Turner, 85, passed away Feb. 25, 2026 in Courtland Healthcare and Rehabilitation Center.

item.title: SCPS strengthens student success through JVG program
item.description: Southampton County Public Schools highlights how the Jobs for Virginia Graduates program at its middle and high schools supports engagement, skills and student success in and beyond the classroom.

item.title: McLemore honors Marcus Garvey’s legacy
item.description: Franklin Councilman Gregory McLemore uses Black History Month presentation to spotlight Marcus Garvey’s global impact on Black pride, self-determination and Pan-African unity.

item.title: Freeman hired as Franklin's new city manager
item.description: Franklin City Council votes 7-0 to hire Newport News official David Freeman, a 35-year government veteran, as the city’s new manager after debate over the hiring process.
